title: An interview with philosopher Thomas Nagel, who won a $1M prize for contributions to consciousness and says the notion of AI consciousness is "just ridiculous" (Steven Levy/Wired)
summary: Steven Levy / Wired: An interview with philosopher Thomas Nagel, who won a $1M prize for contributions to consciousness and says the notion of AI consciousness is “just ridiculous” — Thomas Nagel has done landmark work on consciousness in nonhumans; this week, he won the million-dollar Berggruen Prize for his contributions to the field.
